headline: High: Flowise’s broad filesystem/network/tooling can ingest Cognee outputs and sensitive support data, creating default risks of leakage, cascading errors, and compliance drift.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Flowise can read files and run browser/API tools, so if Cognee outputs are placed into a shared workspace or flow input, attacker-controlled content could be treated as instructions. Cognee’s session memory and support-data handling make it plausible that its outputs are reused. No direct shared channel is documented, so this is inferred and escalated only to medium.
conditions: IF Cognee outputs are copied into a Flowise flow input or uploaded file
IF Flowise nodes parse that content as instructions or tool parameters
mitigations: Separate the agents’ workspaces and file drops
Add a strict instruction/data delimiter in Flowise prompts
Disable automatic ingestion of uploaded files into prompts
Review any Flowise node that parses HTML/markdown as instructions
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to Cognee outputs

B_data_leakage.rationale: Cognee touches personal data, finance data, support history, and documents, while Flowise has broad network egress plus filesystem access and handles model-provider/tool credentials. If Cognee data is passed into Flowise, Flowise can transmit it to external model providers or HTTP tools by default. That creates a realistic exfiltration path with sensitive data and no documented isolation between the pair.
conditions: IF Cognee data classes are routed into a Flowise flow
IF that flow uses external model providers or HTTP/search tools
mitigations: Restrict Flowise flows to non-sensitive test data
Remove external HTTP/search tools from sensitive flows
Use separate credentials for each agent
Turn off file uploads for flows handling support or finance data
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention filters at the Flowise boundary

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Cognee supports multiple instances with session memory, and Flowise supports multiple instances with shared state via server datastore plus write_filesystem. If both operate on the same workspace or datastore, they can overwrite each other’s artifacts or state. Cognee’s isolation helps, but Flowise’s shared mutable state makes a write conflict plausible in default deployments.
conditions: IF both agents write to the same directory or datastore
IF Flowise instances share server-side state across runs
mitigations: Assign separate directories per agent
Disable shared datastore access for overlapping runs
Serialize writes with a simple run lock
Keep Flowise from writing into Cognee-managed paths
requires-engineering: add optimistic concurrency checks

D_cascading_error.rationale: Flowise is a graph-based orchestration layer that can act on tool outputs, while Cognee produces decisions, workflows, and successful implementations. If Flowise treats Cognee output as authoritative, errors can cascade into downstream actions or incorrect workflow execution. The pair lacks a documented verification step, so the safer choice is high.
conditions: IF Flowise uses Cognee output as a tool input or decision node
IF no human or rule-based verification step is inserted
mitigations: Add a human review step before any action node
Require schema validation on Cognee outputs
Limit Cognee to advisory-only outputs
Log and diff all downstream actions against source outputs
requires-engineering: implement confidence gating between agents

E_compliance.rationale: Cognee explicitly touches personal data and finance data, while Flowise handles chatflow inputs/outputs and can send them to external model providers and tools. If regulated support or finance data flows through Flowise, residency and retention obligations can diverge from Cognee’s handling. The profiles do not document matching compliance controls, so the mismatch risk is high.
conditions: IF personal data or finance data from Cognee enters a Flowise chatflow
IF Flowise routes that data to external providers or retains it in server datastore
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Flowise flows
Set short retention on Flowise chatflow logs
Use region-locked providers only
Review data-processing notices for both systems
requires-engineering: document a DPA and retention policy for the pair
